Game Overview

In Green Ninja Collects Apples, the core idea is straightforward: leap through vibrant levels as the agile Green Ninja, collecting apples and dodging perilous traps. Precision and quick reflexes are your allies in this exhilarating quest to claim victory, but beware—touch the dangers, and it's game over. Challenge your reflexes and uncover your high score!

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Green Ninja Collects Apples is easy to pick up. Leap through vibrant levels as the agile Green Ninja, collecting apples and dodging perilous traps.
